summary: Build grant M&E plans, indicators, dashboards, and donor reports in five practical days. Develop evidence-led fundraising skills with TrainingCred.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation for grant writing connects programme results, indicators and evidence to funding proposals and reporting. Designed for grant writers, fundraising managers and programme officers, the course helps practitioners build results chains, select and define indicators, and plan data collection and measurement costs. It also covers using verified evidence to prepare donor reports and performance dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect programme evidence, funding decisions, implementation planning, and donor accountability. It suits intermediate practitioners who already contribute to proposals, programme delivery, reporting, or evaluation and need a more consistent M&E workflow.
prerequisites: Working experience in grant writing, fundraising, programme delivery, monitoring, evaluation, reporting, or nonprofit strategy is recommended. You should be comfortable reading a programme plan and working with basic tables or spreadsheets. No programming is required. Advanced analytics, automated workflows, and evaluation design are introduced at operational or conceptual level rather than production implementation level. Bring a current or representative programme concept if available, with sensitive information removed.
